0022600211.text: The Knicks host the Milwaukee Bucks in their 10th game of the season, with New York at 5-4 (3-2 at home) on a three-game winning streak and sitting 3rd in the Atlantic, 3 games back, and 5th in the East. Milwaukee is 1-9, has lost six straight, and is 5th in the Central, 5.5 games back, and 15th in the East. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Knicks won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 127-98 win in Milwaukee on February 27, 2026. Josh Hart is listed as day-to-day with an ankle injury and is a game-time decision for New York, while Gary Trent Jr. (illness) and Tyler Herro (bruise) are both day-to-day and game-time decisions for Milwaukee.
